excluded_probe.reason: FLEDD returned IRET=0 but EQTIM=0 and repeated the 5.1 s grid; excluded from inference

method.flux: Bilinear SELENE psi(R,Z) at each geo.in loop position. Compare PSRC and MDAC raw EDDB Wb separately, each divided by 2pi after removing the source- and shot-specific median offset across 27 mapped loops.
method.pickup: Bilinear derivatives of SELENE psi at each geo.in probe position, Br=(dpsi/dZ)/R and Bz=-(dpsi/dR)/R. With the listed angle, N=(-sin angle, cos angle); all 17 mapped channels from each source follow -B·N.
method.rogowski: Compare each raw current with SELENE TTCU or SA G-EQDSK current at the named shot. Sign inference requires at least 10% of reference current in both shots.
method.toroidal: PSC/oTFCur is PID 1625 O293; outeddb.c uses positive factor 2.25*2.96/25.7 to produce BTV in T m.
method.profile: Read per-record coordinate selector rather than assign one coordinate system to all profiles.
